isolation: external-directory+observation; host access isolation requires separate enforcement
principle: 受测方仅见题面原文；纪律由环境强制、由 harness 观测，不写进提示词。

trees.workdir: <SANDBOX_RUNS_ROOT>/<model>/<run_id>/; PROMPT.md + opted-in locked input assets + model output
trees.harness: sandbox/runs/<model>/<run_id>/ — orchestrator/reviewer only: meta.json, snapshot.json, REVIEW.md

can_write: workdir tree at prepare time only

sees: registered input assets if profile enabled
tested_model.note: no discipline text, no contract, no result.json requirement — protocol obligations are zero by design

integrity_model.H1: workdir outside repo; location check only, not OS access enforcement
integrity_model.H2: snapshot diff clean — prompt untouched, no forbidden additions
integrity_model.H3: optional transcript scan finds no repo-path tokens
integrity_model.note: replaces self-reported integrity (protocol 1.1 I-checks); result.json is optional and informational only

workdir_files.<deliverables>: whatever the model writes; names normalized to answer.<ext> at collect time

harness_files.meta.json: run metadata; status lifecycle: prepared → reviewed → collected
harness_files.snapshot.json: workdir hashes at prepare time (basis of H2)

verdict_rules.INVALID: observed integrity breach: H1 isolation failed / H2 snapshot polluted / H3 repo-path leak
verdict_rules.FAIL: deliverable red lines: missing deliverable, placeholder tokens, invalid SVG, forbidden entries
verdict_rules.note: missing result.json is NOT a failure

agent_tool_state: forbidden inside sandbox/ and workdirs — keep tool config at repo root or system level

deprecated.protocol_1_1_runs: sandbox/runs/* with protocol_version!=2.0 are marked deprecated; review_run/collect_run refuse them (exit 4)

review_lab.scope: offline comparison UI; NOT part of the tested-model pipeline

bare-vision-v1.payload: verbatim PROJECT_PROMPT.md -> PROMPT.md plus locked PNG whitelist
bare-vision-v1.machine_evaluator_exception: vision_profile.py may read only registered release/scorer/gold; reviewer Agent has no gold access
bare-vision-v1.isolation_verification: unverified until separate host-level evidence review
bare-vision-v1.collect_gate: valid schema + unchanged reviewed snapshot/release/transcript; force cannot override

legacy-vision-explore-v1.payload: only the ```text block of the legacy prompt -> PROMPT.md plus stem_NN images; opaque LV-<sha10> case ids
legacy-vision-explore-v1.machine_evaluator_exception: legacy_vision.py may read the registered gold; reports carry match status, never gold values
legacy-vision-explore-v1.scoring: choice letter / strict JSON fields / Miku yes-no are automatic; free-text substring hits are provisional and misses are pending_human
legacy-vision-explore-v1.isolation_verification: unverified; exploratory, not a formal release

iteration-r6-agent-cli-v1.payload: verbatim frozen public PROMPT.md and PNG assets only
iteration-r6-agent-cli-v1.machine_evaluator_exception: iteration_cli.py summarize may verify the frozen manifest and use its gold with strict-leaf-v1; tested CLIs and reviewer agents have no gold access
iteration-r6-agent-cli-v1.scoring: complete 12-condition family-equal macro score; invalid schemas/integrity and missing answers keep total null
iteration-r6-agent-cli-v1.human_review: deferred_by_user; CLI tests are not human answers

native-godot-v1.entry: prepare_run.py -> review_run.py -> collect_run.py; optional explicit godot_profile.py --run
native-godot-v1.payload: Original PROJECT_PROMPT.md -> PROMPT.md; optional prompt_and_locked_archives via PROMPT_REGISTRY.json with exact locked_inputs SHA-256/size; no scorer/review/cache inputs
native-godot-v1.runtime: fixed engine import and actual GPU boot on an independent copy; unique user://, TEMP/TMP and process
native-godot-v1.scoring: runtime/structure only; six-mode visual and behavior review remains manual; score null
native-godot-v1.isolation_verification: unverified; directory/process/user-data separation does not prove host access confinement
native-godot-v1.collect_gate: reviewed prompt/profile/source/transcript/runtime hashes unchanged; force cannot bypass; valid runtime failures are archived as FAIL
native-godot-v1.archive: <project>/results/<model>/<run_id>/submission retains relative paths, all ordinary dependencies; excludes generated .godot/__pycache__
native-godot-v1.locked_archives: Inputs immutable; extracted source editable; exact initial snapshot; formal and staged archive hashes checked at prepare/review/collect

native_blender_extension.collection: full relative source tree and binary assets; valid FAIL samples retained; INVALID/stale evidence refused
